title: Keynote: Shipping the Web in the Age of AI
abstract: What changes, and what doesn't, when AI writes a growing share of our front-end code.

title: React Server Components in Practice
abstract: Lessons from migrating a production dashboard to server components, including what we rolled back.

title: Prompting Your Way Through Legacy Code
abstract: Practical patterns for giving AI assistants the right context in a large, older codebase.

title: Design Tokens at Scale
abstract: How one team kept five products visually consistent with a single token pipeline.

title: State Management Without the Drama
abstract: Choosing between local state, context, and stores, with real examples of each going wrong.

title: Hands-on: Testing AI-Generated Components
abstract: Bring a laptop. We'll write behavioral tests that catch the mistakes generated code tends to make.

title: Accessible Interactions by Default
abstract: Keyboard support, focus management, and live regions for interactive components.

title: From Figma to Production: A Case Study
abstract: Following one feature from design file to release, including everything the design didn't say.

title: Evaluating LLM Output in CI
abstract: Treat generated code like any other contribution: gate it with tests, lint, and review.

title: CSS Container Queries Deep Dive
abstract: Responsive components that adapt to their container instead of the viewport.

title: Building a Component Library Your Team Will Use
abstract: Adoption, documentation, and API design for shared React components.

title: Closing Panel: What Should We Still Write by Hand?
abstract: Speakers debate where AI assistance helps, where it hurts, and where it doesn't belong.
